data.title: 芙莉莲 · 旷野旅途·苍月草的花海
data.description: 【芙莉莲 · 旷野旅途·苍月草的花海】午后，中央诸国的缓坡铺满盛开的蔚蓝苍月草，花朵从小径两旁一直延伸到远处。芙莉莲手握法杖沿花间小径独自行走，白色斗篷和银白双马尾随风轻扬；她回首望向画面外的同行者，神情平静——「精灵的时间很长，人类的一生很短。但既然答应了陪你同行，无论接下来走多久，我都会记着这段旅程。」
data.action: 手持法杖沿苍月草花海中的窄径行走，回首望向画面外的同行者，斗篷随风扬起
data.lighting: 蔚蓝花田的柔和午后天光
data.camera: wide shot, low angle, blue blossoms visible across the foreground and middle distance
data.promptProse: A dense field of blooming blue flowers spreads across the rolling meadow, with open blossoms filling the foreground and continuing into the middle distance around a narrow walking path. Frieren follows this path with her staff held in one hand, then looks back over her shoulder toward her travelling companion outside the frame. The breeze lifts her pale travel cloak and silver-white twintails above practical trousers and boots; her green eyes remain calm. Soft afternoon daylight reveals the blue petals and the shape of the surrounding flower field. Use a wide, low-angle view that keeps Frieren, her staff and the carpet of blossoms visible together. No lettering.
